name: Horse
desc: A ukiyo-e woodblock horse in beat-locked gallop, flat color block offset from a tapered ink key-line with carving hatch, whipping mane and tail, dust puffs on hoof strikes, plus trot, rearing and grazing-idle gaits and sumi, silhouette and neon skins.

energy.doc: gait amplitude, suspension bounce, mane/tail whip, dust

density.doc: carve hatch, mane strands, dust count

pose.doc: gallop=full suspension stride; trot=diagonal 2-beat; rear=up on hinds pawing on the beat; idle=graze + weight-shift + tail swish

style.doc: aesthetic: ukiyo-e color block + offset ink key-line + hatch / monochrome sumi brush / pure black mass (abstracted) / dark body with glowing contour

act.doc: free=obey pose; journey=idle-trot-gallop-rear cycled by section arc; spook=gait escalates with musical intensity, rears at peaks

seed.doc: deterministic strand, hatch and dust variation
